summary: RAGFlow publishes almost no quantitative results about itself. The only accuracy and token numbers (BrowseComp-Plus 85%, FRAMES 91%, a 38% average token reduction) sit in one docs essay with no data or eval script, and a release note claims a 50–100% latency reduction without evidence. It does ship runnable harnesses (an HTTP chat/retrieval benchmark CLI, manual DeepDoc PDF throughput tests, a Go agent-eval framework) but commits no results from them. Retrieval benchmarking on ms_marco/trivia_qa/miracl is mentioned only in old release notes (docs/release_notes.md:1396-1399) and has no corresponding code in the current tree.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
